description: Fly to an absolute destination and hold position. Completion means reaching the requested position and altitude, followed by idle hold.
name: Go to

description: Land at the current location and disarm. Completion means touchdown and disarm; the maneuver cannot be ordinarily cancelled once started.
name: Land

description: Return to launch, land, and disarm for recovery. Completion means recovery at launch; the maneuver cannot be ordinarily cancelled once started.
name: Return to launch

description: Climb an already-armed aircraft to the requested altitude and settle into a hover. Completion means reaching the altitude and holding; arming is never performed by this command.
name: Takeoff
